missing.description: ONLY for decision ask: the essential inputs that have NO value anywhere in the customer's messages and cannot be defaulted: items (what kind of things to collect), place (where, when the request needs one), source (which account, page or link), platform. Empty for plan and cannot. A decision ask with this list empty is refused by code.

accepts_available.description: true only when the customer's answer to a question about what the real search found accepts what exists

people_of_companies.description: ALWAYS answered: whether the customer wants the PEOPLE who work at the companies (or businesses) of the request

title_ar.description: those people as the customer named them, Arabic plural; empty when asked is false

per_company.description: how many PEOPLE the customer asked for EACH company; never the number of companies; 0 when not given

per_company_text.description: the customer's own words that gave per_company, exactly as written; empty when per_company is 0

companies_text.description: the customer's own words that gave the number of COMPANIES, exactly as written; empty when no number of companies was given

contact_kinds.description: the PERSON contacts the customer asked for those people; empty when none

key.description: short id: lowercase letters, digits, underscore

title_ar.description: the items of this step in Arabic, plural (التغريدات، التعليقات، الردود …)

parent.description: the key of the EARLIER step whose items this step reads from (empty for a top-level step)

deliver.description: true when the customer wants these items in the file (false only for an intermediate step they did not ask to receive)

total.description: omit when the customer gave no total

per_parent.description: omit when not given per parent

source.description: omit when no source was named

topic.description: omit when there is no topic

period.description: omit when no period was asked

fields_wanted.description: fields the customer explicitly asked for (link, author, date, likes…)
